We have updated Vacation: dayOFF to be available in Korean language through settings.
Now, overseas Korean users can enjoy Vacation: dayOFF without difficulty.
We are very happy to be able to share this news, we are very happy, and very happy.
Thank you.

notes.title: Donation price cut & korean language & Function improvement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711844/22c6c05e3839f32a79e83a064109e08c557e59d2.png[/img]

Hello. We are Vacation: dayOFF developers. Thankfully, we are preparing an update to answer valuable feedback from users who have played our application.
Hangul addition and inconvenience function improvement are scheduled.
And we decided to lower the price of Late-Purchase to a new price from the same price as when we launched it on mobile. Accordingly, the amount of sponsorship in mobile applications will be reduced equally. Please tell us if you want a refund if you first sponsored the reduced price before it is applied to the store. We are not familiar with Steam yet, so we have to check the procedure a little more, but we promise to refund you if you wish.
Holidays-It's a national holiday, and I'm so happy to have time to prepare for the update. Have fun and be healthy for everyone.
Thank you.
(It was written through Google Translator.)
